FormModule.Title: OPIALLOX
FormModule.Comment:
module modified by Simon using JDAPI_LAF on Monday 08 September 2008 15:5:6* Abstract:
* This form allows an operator to allocate products to an order for
* the Serve*Care system.
*
* Error Conditions:
* '0000' - transaction committed
* '0200' - Invalid function key
* '0306' - Invalid order number
* '0318' - A 'Y' or 'N' must be entered
* '0322' - Invalid product type
* '0600' - Unsuccessful commit... transaction not saved
* '0601' - No changes to commit
* '1705' - Invalid order type
* '2202' - Suitable products not found. Enter another search criteria
* '2203' - No substitution criteria selected
* '2301' - Enter 'Y' and 'N' and press [NXTFLD]
* '2404' - Units allocated to a work order must be in the ratio of
* '2701' - All units requested have been allocated
* '2702' - Enter 'X' and Press [MENU] to allocate
* '2703' - No Units have been allocated to this order
* '2704' - Enough units have been allocated to this item
* '2706' - No units available to allocate
* '2709' - No units available to substitute
* '2710' - No units available for work order
* '2711' - Enter 'X' and press [NXTFLD] or [NXTBLK] to continue
* '2712' - Stock allocated press [COMMIT] to save changes
* '2713' - Changes made press [COMMIT] to save changes
*
* Inputs:
* Order Number
*
* Outputs:
* Pick Slip ID - Screen
* Pick Slip Report - Printout
*
* Modules Referenced:
* handle_error - SRVLIB
* check_package_failure - SRVLIB
* post_transaction - SRVLIB
* commit_transaction - SRVLIB
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
* None.
*
* Functional Descriptions:
*
* 1. Enter an Order Type either from the keyboard or from a list
* of values will be the list of available ORDER_TYPE's. This
* field can be defaulted to either Regular, Special or Export
* order types by specifying the value in the global variable
* :GLOBAL.order_type. Every time the screen is run this value
* is passed to OPIALLOC and only that particular value is
* available to the operator.
*
* 2. Enter an Order No. either from the keyboard or from a list of
* values. The list of values will be the list of Order No's
* from the ORDERS table that have a status of 'OR' - ordered,
* 'BO' - back ordered. The list of ORDERS will be sorted by
* order class (STAT first, ASAP second, Routine third), among
* each order class they will be ordered by order status (Ordered
* first, Back Ordered second) then among each order status they
* will be ordered by date and time of order taken.
*
* 3. Display the ORDER_NO, CUSTOMER_NAME, ORDER_TYPE,
* ORDER_STATUS, DATE and TIME on the order, for all available
* orders. The operator then selects an order to allocate and
* presses the [NXTFLD] key.
*
* 4. Display the ITEM_NO, PRODUCT_CODE, ABORh, QTY_REQUIRED,
* QTY_ALLOCATED, and ITEM_STATUS for each line item of the
* selected order.
*
* 5. Enter 'X' beside all line items to be allocated. An 'X' can
* be entered either by the pressing 'X' key or by pressing
* [ENTQRY]. Pressing the [ENTQRY] key will select all the line
* items for the selected order that have not been allocated
* completely.
*
* 6. Next, press the [MENU] key to allocate each line selected.
* Each line item selected will be processed individually. If
* components are found that match the line item being processed
* then:
* 1. A Pop-up is shown displaying the UNIT_ID,
* PRODUCT_CODE, ABORh, EXPIRATION_DATE, quantity needed,
* quantity found for components that
* match the line item selected.
*
* However, if no products were found that matched the criteria
* specified in the order then a routine will evaluate substitutions
* based on the following criteria:
* 1. Online customer preferences for substitions.
* 2. FDA approved substitutions for blood types.
* 3. FDA approved product substitutions.
* 4. Later outdate ranges.
* 5. Earlier outdate ranges.
* If suitable products are found then a substitution pop-up
* screen will allow the operator to query the database based on
* five separate criteria:
* 1. Alternate Tiers (other outdates)
* 2. By different Blood Types
* 3. By different Product Codes and Types
* 4. By Ignoring the product's Inventory Class
* 5. By source products for processed types
* If no suitable products are found then a pop-up prompts the
* operator to place the line item on back order status.
*
* Derived products are not stocked in great quantities
* and therefore must be processed as the need arises. When a
* derived product is ordered then allocation will generate a
* work order pick slip.
*
* 7. Enter 'X' beside all units to be allocated. An 'X' can be
* entered by pressing 'X' or by pressing [ENTQRY]. Pressing
* the [ENTQRY] key will select as many units are required to
* fill the line item.
*
* 8. Press the [MENU] key. The quantity needed is decremented
* for every unit allocated to the line item. The units as
* they are allocated are removed from the display and placed
* in the block below, indicating that the unit has been
* allocated.
*
* 9. Update the product status to 'AL' - Allocated if the line
* item is completely allocated, or 'BO' - Back Ordered if the
* line item was only partially filled.
*
* 10. At the point of allocating a unit, the operator has the
* option to deallocate that unit. To do this, the operator
* presses the [NXTBLK] key to go to the allocated block.
*
* 11. Enter 'X' beside all units to be deallocated. An 'X' can
* be entered by pressing 'X' or by pressing [ENTQRY].
* Pressing [ENTQRY] will select all the units in the
* allocated block.
*
* 12. Press the [MENU] key. The quantity needed is incremented
* for every unit deallocated are removed from the display and
* placed in the block above, indicating that the unit has
* been deallocated.
*
* 13. Press the [EXIT] key to exit the pop-up and go on to the
* next line or exit to the main screen if all line items
* selected have been processed.
*
* 14. Update the order status to allocated or back ordered.
*
* 15. Press the [COMMIT] key to save allocation to the database
* and print the pick slip.
*
* 16. Press the [EXIT] key to exit the form. If the [EXIT] key is
* pressed before the changes are commited then the operator is
* is prompted 'Do you really want to exit without saving your
* changes?'. Answering 'Y' will exit the operator out of the
* screen without saving the changes. Answering 'N' will allow
* operator to commit the changes made.
*
***************************************************************************

 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :order_items.select = 'X'
 then
 some_selected := 'TRUE';
 exit;
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 go_record('1');

 then
 if :order_items.required_qty - :order_items.allocated_qty
 - :order_items.canceled_qty > 0

 end if;

 end if;

 execute_trigger('key-down');
 check_package_failure;
 end loop;
 go_record(temp);
 execute_trigger('after_move');
end;

procedure update_status is
 ordered_count number := 0;
 allocated_count number := 0;
 partial_count number := 0;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 exception
 when others then 
 tackle_error('TimeZone Convert');
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 -- 
 if (:order_items.required_qty - :order_items.allocated_qty
 - :order_items.canceled_qty) > 0
 then
 if (:order_items.allocated_qty > 0)
 or :GLOBAL.back_ordered = 'TRUE'
 then
 :order_items.item_status := 'BO';
 elsif (:order_items.allocated_qty = 0)
 then
 :order_items.item_status := 'OR';
 end if;
 else
 :order_items.item_status := 'AL';
 end if;
 post_transaction;
 begin
 select code_desc into :status
 from vserv_order_status
 where code = :order_items.item_status and
 chp_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :order_items.item_status := NULL;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :order_items.item_status = 'BO'
 then
 partial_count := partial_count + 1;
 elsif :order_items.item_status = 'OR'
 then
 ordered_count := ordered_count + 1;
 elsif :order_items.item_status = 'AL'
 then
 allocated_count := allocated_count + 1;
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 if partial_count > 0 or
 (allocated_count > 0 and ordered_count > 0)
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.order_status := 'BO';
 elsif ordered_count = 0
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.order_status := 'AL';
 elsif allocated_count = 0
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.order_status := 'OR';
 end if;
 begin
 select code_desc
 into :status_name
 from vserv_order_status
 where code = :ctrl_blk_1.order_status and
 chp_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 post_transaction;
end;
